Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is very simple.
Basic steps:
Put a small amount of moisture on the tragus (the small protrusion on your ear).
Place the earpiece on your left ear, with the electrodes on the tragus. Let the cable go over and behind your ear to keep it secure.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling in your ear. 
Session length: about 15–60 minutes. You can sit, relax, or continue normal activities while using it.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually adjust so the sensation stays comfortable.
